title: Notes on the desktop
description: Independent notes stay close to the work. Each can float above other windows.

title: Quick capture
description: A draggable desktop note with a ready cursor. Its only window control is a green minus that saves and puts it away.

title: Formatted note
description: The same floating note window, showing supported Markdown, checklists, and inline tags.

title: Markdown source
description: Markdown source stays in the same independent desktop window, with one green Put away control.

title: Note actions
description: Right-click or use the app menu for note actions. The window keeps only its green Put away button.

title: Menu bar capture
description: The resident menu bar opens a floating note even when the library and all note windows are closed.

title: Notes library
description: A searchable home for open and closed notes in the selected collection.

title: First local note
description: Local capture is available immediately, without an account.

title: Filter by tags
description: Tags are derived from note text. Multiple selected tags use AND.

title: Archive
description: Archived notes remain searchable and can be returned to Notes.

title: Trash and restore
description: Deleted notes can be restored for 30 days.

title: Delete permanently
description: A separate confirmation explains irreversible removal and offline copies.

title: Word search
description: Search body text, derived titles, and tags without a cloud round trip.

title: No search matches
description: An empty result gives a clear way back without inventing an answer.

title: Search by meaning
description: Natural-language retrieval returns saved notes and matched excerpts.

title: Enable meaning search
description: An explicit model download choice explains on-device processing. The size is illustrative until M0.

title: Model download
description: Pause or cancel the download while word search remains available.

title: Preparing meaning search
description: The app explains indexing progress while keeping capture available.

title: Meaning search unavailable
description: An unsupported device can continue with word search.

title: Choose saving mode
description: Choose free remote periodic device sync or paid whole-library live Cloud sync.

title: Connect Synkies Cloud
description: Sign in to Synkies to open the account’s cloud collection.

title: Waiting for authorization
description: System-browser authorization can be completed or cancelled without blocking local work.

title: Downloading cloud notes
description: Initial progress is visible; partial results are not presented as a complete collection.

title: Enable Cloud for all notes
description: Explicitly authorize the complete library upload after paid-plan verification. Keep local copies until acknowledged.

title: Switch library to On-device
description: Verify a complete device copy before leaving Cloud. Cancellation and cloud-data removal are separate.

title: Sign out of Synkies
description: Choose whether downloaded copies stay. Unsynced edits have a recovery path.

title: Change Synkies account
description: Account switching preserves pending work and separates collections.

title: General settings
description: Configure quick capture, launch behavior, and appearance.

title: Storage settings
description: App-wide mode, paired devices, local folder, and paid Cloud plan in one place.

title: Search settings
description: Manage the local search model and derived index.

title: Export your notes
description: Portable Markdown and metadata make leaving straightforward.

title: Import notes
description: Import into the current mode, with sync/upload consequences shown before proceeding.

title: Import results
description: Imported, skipped, and oversized notes are reported explicitly.

title: Offline and saved locally
description: Cloud notes remain editable. Local success and cloud status are separate.

title: Sign in to sync again
description: Expired authorization does not prevent local editing.

title: Cloud sync paused
description: A cloud error pauses sync while preserving local changes.

title: Local save failed
description: The note stays open, with Retry and Copy text available.

title: Compare concurrent versions
description: Both offline versions survive until the person chooses how to resolve them.

title: Combine versions
description: Merge the text or keep separate notes; neither version is silently discarded.

title: Cloud collection missing
description: Local copies remain available while the person chooses a recovery action.

title: Local folder unavailable
description: A disconnected local drive does not trigger a hidden change of storage location.

title: Update required
description: A newer storage schema is kept intact instead of being rewritten by an older app.

title: Note length limit
description: An oversized paste is rejected explicitly, with the existing text preserved.

title: Shortcut unavailable
description: A conflicting shortcut can be replaced without blocking menu bar capture.

title: iPhone notes library
description: A compact two-column library with direct capture and collection selection.

title: iPhone note editor
description: Readable paper, touch checkboxes, and a clear local-save status.

title: iPhone quick capture
description: The editor opens with the keyboard ready. Closing keeps the note.

title: iPhone Markdown source
description: The same source text is available on the phone.

title: iPhone search
description: Word and meaning search share the same collection boundaries.

title: iPhone tag filters
description: An accessible bottom sheet keeps filtering within reach.

title: iPhone saving mode
description: Choose a free On-device library or paid Cloud for all notes.

title: iPhone note actions
description: A touch action sheet exposes sync status, archive, export, and delete.

title: iPhone settings
description: Storage and search settings use the same vocabulary as Mac.

title: iPhone conflict resolution
description: Stacked versions preserve legibility on a small screen.

title: iPhone Trash
description: Recovery actions stay available on mobile.

title: iPhone mode switch
description: Switching applies to the entire library and keeps a verified local copy.

title: Browser notes library
description: The same notes and navigation in a browser application shell. The URL is illustrative.

title: Browser note editor
description: Open a cloud note without losing the library context.

title: Browser first use
description: Start locally or sign in to Synkies, without implying access to a Mac local folder.

title: Browser offline
description: Cached notes remain available without a network connection.

title: Browser storage settings
description: Browser storage limitations, persistence status, and export are explicit.

title: Browser storage is full
description: Unsaved text has an immediate copy/export recovery path.

title: Android browser layout
description: A responsive browser layout provides Android access without a native Android app.

title: Create a Synkies account
description: An account is needed for paid Cloud. Signing in alone does not activate Cloud or upload the On-device library.

title: Verify email
description: Email verification protects the cloud account.

title: Reset password
description: Recover access without changing local notes.

title: Delete Synkies account
description: Account deletion requires an explicit confirmation and explains retention.

title: Account deletion status
description: A clear status distinguishes signing out from deleting server data.

title: Choose new password
description: Complete password recovery with a reset code.

title: iPhone meaning search
description: Meaning search retrieves source notes, using the local index.

title: iPhone library menu
description: Archive, Trash, and Settings stay easy to reach.

title: iPhone Archive
description: Archived notes remain available on the phone.

title: Archived note editor
description: Archived notes remain editable and can be unarchived.

title: Browser local note
description: A local browser note needs no account and never uploads implicitly.

title: Notes Library and desktop
description: Open the full Notes Library while pinned notes remain on the desktop. Drag a card outside the library window to pin it.

title: Drag a note onto the desktop
description: A drag preview shows where the same note will be pinned. Its library mode stays unchanged.

title: Pinned from the library
description: The note stays in the library with an On desktop indicator. Both views share one identity.

title: Right-click to pin
description: Right-click a library card for Pin to desktop. Already open notes offer Bring to front or Remove from desktop.

title: Arrange open notes menu
description: Window offers four edge arrangements, configurable shortcuts, and Undo last arrangement.

title: Arrange notes left
description: Control Option Command Left arrow arranges open notes at the left edge of the active display.

title: Arrange notes right
description: Control Option Command Right arrow arranges open notes at the right edge.

title: Arrange notes top
description: Control Option Command Up arrow arranges open notes along the top.

title: Arrange notes bottom
description: Control Option Command Down arrow arranges open notes along the bottom.

title: Desktop and shortcuts
description: Pinning, always-on-top behavior, library access, and configurable edge arrangement shortcuts.

title: Library closed, notes visible
description: The Notes Library is closed. The independent note window remains visible on the macOS desktop, with one Save and close control.

title: On-device notes
description: Free notes live on paired devices. Remote sync is periodic and never creates a server-stored note copy.

title: Your paired devices
description: Last sync, remote reachability, Sync now, pairing and unpairing are explicit.

title: Pair another device
description: Pairing authenticates a device before sharing any notes. The example code is a mockup.

title: Confirm the paired device
description: Verify the same device phrase on both devices before exchanging the library.

title: Waiting for a device
description: Keep work locally until a paired device has an overlapping online sync opportunity.

title: Periodic device sync
description: Local saving is already complete while a remote peer commits the latest changes.

title: Remote encrypted connection
description: An encrypted transient relay helps peers connect across networks. No note copy is retained on the relay.

title: Latest edit applied
description: The newer peer edit becomes current automatically. Recent versions offer optional recovery.

title: Recent local versions
description: Replaced text remains on a device for seven days. Recovery creates a new edit or separate note.

title: Unpair a device
description: Unpairing stops future exchange and explains that an offline device can retain its existing copy.

title: Paid Cloud plan
description: Cloud includes the entire library and live sync. Price remains undecided; no charge occurs in this mockup.

title: Activating Cloud for all notes
description: Keep complete local copies until the initial whole-library upload is acknowledged.

title: Cloud live sync
description: Committed Cloud changes push to active online devices. Offline devices catch up on return.

title: Cloud subscription
description: Show server-verified plan status and separate subscription management from cloud-data removal.

title: Cloud payment needs attention
description: A payment problem pauses Cloud without deleting local notes or preventing capture/export.

title: Cancel Cloud renewal
description: Cancellation stops renewal according to plan terms. It does not silently remove notes.

title: Cloud plan expired
description: Keep local work usable and make recovery, downgrade and retention next steps explicit.

title: Verify the complete device copy
description: Finish the full download and pending-edit reconciliation before activating On-device mode.

title: Remove retained Cloud data
description: Cloud-data removal is separate from mode switching, account deletion and canceling renewal.

title: Cloud data removal requested
description: On-device replicas remain available while server data removal follows the published retention policy.

title: iPhone On-device notes
description: Free local replicas sync periodically with paired devices, including remotely.

title: iPhone paired devices
description: Show remote peer status and the fact that suspended apps sync when iOS allows or on return.

title: iPhone device pairing
description: Confirm a device code before sharing the On-device library.

title: Browser On-device notes
description: This browser keeps a local replica and periodically exchanges updates with paired devices.

title: Browser device pairing
description: Explicit browser pairing links a local replica without paid Cloud or a server note copy.
